title: PRI-PRE-003 evidence: retention design missing
description: Structural measurability check only: whether governed data is declared present, and if so, a complete five-field retention design. This does not verify a declared retention period against a real storage system setting -- see docs/governance-contract.md and the control's own ASSESSMENT.md. Independent of this control's existing Azure Policy demo (infra/policy-definition.bicep), which evaluates deployment-request tags directly and never reads this file.

version.description: Only the currently implemented evidence-shape version is accepted. A future breaking change to this control's evidence shape bumps this const, not a version registry.

governedDataPresent.description: Whether this agent is declared to hold governed data. The gate below only applies when this is true.

retentionPeriodDays.description: Unsigned integer of 1-5 digits, matching this control's Azure Policy demo's own numeric-format check.
